description: List available skills (name + description). Use skill_view(name) to load full content.
name: skills_list

category.description: Optional category filter to narrow results

query.description: Optional situation words to find a skill by what you are trying to do, e.g. '翻页丢状态' or '对账 迁移'. Every whitespace-separated term must appear in a skill's name, description, category or trigger words; omit it to list everything.
